name: Rossell India Limited
summary: Rossell India Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of tea primarily in India. It also offers black pepper. In addition, the company exports its products to Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and other countries. The company was formerly known as Rossell Tea Limited and changed its name to Rossell India Limited in April 2011. Rossell India Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
